admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: Minute of the garden table. The question before the table was whether the south window boxes are to be replanted with the saved marigold seed or left to the self-sown poppies for one more year. The table has decided the question: the boxes are to be replanted with the saved marigold seed, and the decision takes effect with the next dry morning. The garden keeper will draw the seed from the second drawer and enter the sowing in the planting book. Nothing in this minute touches the long beds, which keep their standing plan.
